svg.title: ARMOR-VISION architecture
svg.desc: ARMOR-VISION takes the pictures or the detections of a camera, checks motion first, follows each object, applies the zones, masks and arming profiles and prints events that never authorise an action. ARMOR-SERVER-AI is the service that watches the cameras today; the real detector model for the Jetson Orin NX is not written yet.

svg.text: Decides what a camera picture means: zones, masks, motion, a tracker and the rules that turn detections into events that only report.
